summary: T111 contract retargeted from T109 to T112 as the current registry-bound evidence source. Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance and References now speak of T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence; the legacy adapter path is re-described as historical-only compatibility for legacy readers of a T109 manifest. T109 is preserved only as a historical read-only predecessor. T111.depends_on is unchanged ([T101, T102, T106, T110]) and T112 reaches T111 transitively through T110 (A0035); todo/config.yaml was not modified.
rationale: Per A0026 impact A0026:T111:repoint-to-t112-when-approved, the existing T111.md treated a T109 manifest as the current registry-bound evidence source for the approved-consumer compatibility adapter that drives T101, T102 and T106. T112 has since replaced T109 as the current product-run evidence source (paired-version manifest + paired simulation-evidence, fill-cursor preservation, real T100 partition bytes), and T110 already binds T112 through A0035, so T111 is reachable through T110. The smallest CONTRACT-layer change that retargets current-evidence language without touching depends_on, without weakening any Must-not clause, and without introducing implementation work is to edit only todo/phases/P06-backtesting-and-strategy/T111.md: the Outcome and Acceptance paragraphs now speak of current T112 artifacts; the Deliverables paragraph now describes the adapter as reading a T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence (bound to immutable T100 partition references) and explicitly preserves historical-only compatibility for legacy readers of a T109 manifest through the versioned legacy reader; the References paragraph adds T112 and a sentence noting T112 is the current registry-bound source while T109 is preserved only as a historical read-only predecessor. The Must-not block is byte-identical (no weakening). T111.depends_on is unchanged; per A0035, T110 already binds T112. The contract_status field stays OWNER_BOOTSTRAP_SPLIT_2026_09_21 because this amendment repairs that contract's current-evidence clause rather than replacing its bootstrap lineage. affected_existing_tasks is empty because the only target task (T111) is the one being amended and no other downstream or sibling task contract now asserts something a governing document no longer says. resolved_task_impacts contains the exact existing A0026-prefixed impact ID; no new impact is raised. No code, no test, no persisted artifact, no schema, no workflow state, no attempt, no commit, no attempt-recovery state, and no .env/keystore/credential is touched.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable. docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md speaks at goal level (G-HISTORICAL-REPLAY-01, G-RUN-REPLAY-01) and does not bind the T111 adapter to a specific numbered task contract; no Intent clause asserts T109 as the current product-run evidence source. No Intent revision is opened or required.
impact_assessment.specification: Not applicable. The Spec layer (docs/spec/product, docs/spec/strategy, docs/spec/operations, docs/spec/security, docs/spec/architecture, docs/spec/protocol) and the cited references (DS-002, DS-005-DS-007, ADR-006, ADR-014, R17) describe requirements at the dataset, evidence, registry/schema and run-state level rather than naming T109 as the current product-run writer for the T111 adapter. The retarget is a contract-language change inside T111.md only; no Spec file is touched and no Spec revision is required.
impact_assessment.contracts: Target contract T111.md (todo/phases/P06-backtesting-and-strategy/T111.md) is retargeted: Outcome now reads 'current T112 dataset-referenced artifacts and paired simulation-evidence' and adds 'T109 is preserved only as a historical read-only predecessor and is not a current evidence source'; Deliverables now describes the adapter as reading a T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence bound to immutable T100 partition references, re-describes the T109 path as historical-only compatibility for legacy readers, and tightens the read-only scope to 'historical T105 and T109 artifacts' so the adapter applies only to current T112 artifacts; Acceptance now drives tests with two current T112 artifacts, rejects a T109-versioned record offered as current with a named reason, and changes the authority pair from 'T109/T110' to 'T112/T110'; References adds T112 and a sentence naming T112 as the current registry-bound source with T109 retained only as a historical read-only predecessor. The Must-not block is byte-identical. Dependencies stay [T101, T102, T106, T110]. The contract_status field stays OWNER_BOOTSTRAP_SPLIT_2026_09_21 because this amendment repairs the bootstrap-split contract's current-evidence clause rather than replacing it; the bootstrap lineage is preserved.
impact_assessment.dependencies: Not applicable as a change. T111.depends_on remains [T101, T102, T106, T110] and todo/config.yaml is not modified. T112 is reachable through T110 via the A0035 binding (T110.md Dependencies already lists T112 and todo/config.yaml T110 entry already includes T112 in depends_on). The amendment does not add a direct T111 -> T112 edge; it inherits T112 transitively. No DEPENDENCY category is raised.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable. No code under src/, no test under tests/, no fixture, no oracle, no docs/implement entry, no dependency manifest, no pyproject.toml and no requirements.lock.txt is touched. CONTRACT-layer retargeting only. The Developer who later implements T111 will read the corrected contract and use T112 evidence; this amendment does not pre-write code, tests or fixtures.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable. No persisted data, no manifest, no simulation-evidence, no approval artifact, no attempt commit, no evidence pointer, no review record, no candidate lock, no robustness report, no Web persisted view and no historical T069/T105/T109 record is touched. T109 historical artifacts remain on their versioned read-only path and T112 evidence is produced only after the existing T112 contract is independently APPROVED; this amendment neither creates T112 artifacts nor rewrites T109 artifacts. No DATA category is raised.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable. No active_task, active_phase, workflow_state, intent_revision, spec_revision, plan-structure revision, agent_runtime, attempt, base_commit, candidate_commit, approved_commit, evidence, review record or single-active-work lane is changed. T112 remains active_task at P06. No new maintenance, continuation or amendment-resume gate is opened. No OPERATIONS category is raised.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. The change is contract-language only and explicitly forbids weakening any Must-not clause (signer, execution, risk, approval, paper-promotion, risk authority, registry/schema/hash/revision checks). No private key, keystore password, signing payload, endpoint credential, webhook, .env value, RPC URL or authorization header is introduced, printed, persisted or read. No SECURITY category is raised.
impact_assessment.verification: Not applicable as a change. No test is deleted, no acceptance criterion is relaxed, no tolerance is widened, no safety gate is loosened and no ignored check is added. The corrected contract re-targets the integration tests (real T101 panel/harness and T106 robustness runner) and the call-graph/architecture tests to T112 evidence and requires T109-versioned records offered as current to be rejected with a named reason; the underlying coverage of identity/byte/schema/revision fail-closed behavior is preserved. The Developer who later implements T111 will run pytest, Ruff format/check and strict mypy against the corrected contract. No VERIFICATION category is raised.
